opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage as a paid participation plan, identifying a $28 joining amount plus a $10 smart-chain fee and saying, "with $28 you can start work here and with $28 you can earn huge money." The presentation then promotes multiple slots across the plan, including X3 and X4, and ties those starting slots to bringing in people. It describes entrants changing slot placement and says the first two entrants may provide no payment while payments can go to a senior and his team. These mechanics establish recruitment-linked, tiered participation and placement-dependent nonpayment, although the exact calculations and any completed payments or losses remain unclear.
